楚梦瑶觉得陈雨舒说的也有一定的道理，于是也就同意了下来。
忽然又转头问福伯道：“福伯，你给他买保险了么？万一他出了什么意外的话……”
“买保险？”
福伯再次大汗，心道，楚先生请来的人，哪里那么容易就会出意外？不过还是说道：
“放心吧，都买好了……”
而这时候，林逸已经走到了车子边上，拉开门坐进了车里，看着楚梦瑶道：
“怎么样？还算可以吧？”
“算你勉强过关吧。”
楚梦瑶哼了一声。
林逸笑了笑，坐回了副驾驶的位置上。
他并没有多说什么，经验和网络告诉他，女人很多情况下都是口是心非的动物，所以林逸也不会和楚梦瑶争辩什么。
见林逸只是笑了笑，就不再说话，楚梦瑶就气不打一处来，还以为他会说一些感激涕零的话呢！
要知道，现在的社会竞争如此激烈，大学毕业生还有掏粪去的呢，一个刚刚进城的民工，就找到了一个如此好的工作，他应该很高兴才对呀？
“喂，你怎么不感谢我一下？”
楚梦瑶终于忍不住了，有些气恼的问道。
“感谢？感谢什么？”
林逸有些莫名其妙，心道，我帮你将那个纠缠你的男生给踢了一个狗啃泥，你应该感谢我才对啊？
我感谢你什么？
“我……”

楚梦瑶气得不行，这人怎么反应迟钝呢？
这么暗示他，他还不明白什么意思么？难道他不懂得如何讨好雇主？
“嘻嘻，瑶瑶的意思是，她接受了你，你不表示一下感谢么？”
陈雨舒狡黠的一笑，在一旁替楚梦瑶解释道。
“小舒，你胡说什么？什么我接受他了？”
楚梦瑶听了陈雨舒的话吓了一跳，这话的歧义也太大了点儿吧？怎么听起来像接受表白似的呢？
“没什么呀，我说你接受他做你的挡箭牌了嘛！”
陈雨舒笑嘻嘻的说道。
“哦，谢谢。”
林逸倒是很利落，事实上，要不是这份工作怪异了一些，他总体上还是很满意的，起码薪水很高。
“不客气……”
楚梦瑶恨恨的从嘴里蹦出三个字来，为林逸的反应迟钝赶到无比的怨念。
这个人给自己当挡箭牌？怎么看他都是傻兮兮的呢？
“瑶瑶姐，我走了，明天见呀，还有你，箭牌哥。”
车子停在了一座别墅门前，陈雨舒对楚梦瑶摆了摆手又对车子前面的林逸眨了眨眼，才下了车去。
箭牌哥？林逸苦笑，这个名称倒是挺别致的，和网络日天哥有的一拼了。
陈雨舒的家和楚梦瑶住的很近，两家的别墅门对门，车头转个弯，就来到了楚梦瑶的别墅。
在陈雨舒的怂恿之下，楚梦瑶勉强的接受了眼前这位民工。
不过，当她看到民工拎着行李和她一起走进别墅时，顿时又炸庙了：“你……你跟着我做什么？”
林逸一愣，莫名其妙的转头看向了福伯：“难道我不住在这里么？”

“你这个人倒是挺自作多情的，我的小别墅里还没进过男人呢！”
楚梦瑶一掐腰，凶巴巴的对林逸吼道。
福伯抹了抹头上的冷汗，没进过男人？那我算什么……
福伯心道，自己变成太监倒是无所谓，不过楚先生要是听到小姐这句话，不知道会作何感想呢？
看到福伯擦汗，楚梦瑶立刻也明白了自己的话似乎有些歧义了，于是忙改口道：“我是说没有进过，我家人之外的男人！”
“小姐，楚先生说了，您可以将林先生当做自己的哥哥一样融洽相处的……所以，林先生从今天开始，就住在别墅里面了。”
福伯小心的说道。这个小姑奶奶的脾气福伯可是一清二楚。
“什么！”
楚梦瑶顿时瞪大了眼睛，一脸不可思议的指着林逸：“他？我哥哥？开什么玩笑啊！福伯，你把他带走，让他随便住哪里都行！”
“这个恐怕我没办法做主，小姐，这是楚先生交代的，您看……”
福伯有些为难的说道。
毕竟他是一个司机，虽然是楚鹏展最信任的人，但是夹在他和小姐中间，实在不好办啊！
“算了，我亲自和爹地说好了！”
楚梦瑶从口袋里掏出了一只最新款的苹果手机拨了出去，是前一阵子上市的，她和陈雨舒一人买了一只。
林逸则是有些眼馋的看着楚梦瑶手中的手机，自己是不是也应该买一台呢？
不然打电话实在太不方便了。
“爹地，我是遥遥呀！”

Chu Mengyao felt that what Chen Yushu said made sense, so she agreed.
Suddenly he turned around and asked Uncle Fu: "Uncle Fu, have you bought insurance for him? If something happens to him..."
"Buy insurance?"
Uncle Fu sweated profusely again and thought to himself, how could the people invited by Mr. Chu have accidents so easily? But he still said:
"Don't worry, I've bought everything..."
At this time, Lin Yi had already walked to the car, opened the door and got into the car, looked at Chu Mengyao and said:
"How's it going? Not bad, right?"
"Let's just say you can barely get by."
Chu Mengyao snorted.
Lin Yi smiled and sat back in the passenger seat.
He didn't say much. Experience and the Internet told him that women are often duplicitous animals, so Lin Yi would not argue with Chu Mengyao.
Seeing that Lin Yi just smiled and stopped talking, Chu Mengyao became so angry that she thought he would say some words of gratitude!
You know, the competition in today's society is so fierce, and college graduates still have to dig out excrement. A migrant worker who has just entered the city has found such a good job. He should be very happy, right?
"Hey, why don't you thank me?"
Chu Mengyao finally couldn't help it anymore and asked angrily.
"Thank you? Thank you for what?"
Lin Yi was a little confused and thought to himself, I helped you kick the boy who was pestering you to the ground. You should thank me, right?
What do I thank you for?
"I..."
Chu Mengyao was so angry, why was this person so slow to react?
Doesn't he still understand what you mean by hinting at him like this? Doesn't he know how to please his employer?
"Hehe, Yaoyao means that she accepted you, don't you express your gratitude?"
Chen Yushu smiled slyly and explained for Chu Mengyao.
"Xiao Shu, what are you talking about? Why did I accept him?"
Chu Mengyao was shocked when she heard Chen Yushu's words. Isn't the ambiguity of these words too high? Why does it sound like you are accepting a confession?
"It's nothing. I said you accepted him as your shield!"
Chen Yushu said with a smile.
"Oh, thank you."
Lin Yi is very neat. In fact, if this job wasn't a bit weird, he would be very satisfied overall. At least the salary is very high.
"You're welcome..."
Three words popped out of Chu Mengyao's mouth bitterly, feeling extremely resentful for Lin Yi's slow reaction.
Is this person using him as a shield? Why do you think he is so stupid?
"Sister Yaoyao, I'm leaving. I'll see you tomorrow, and you, Brother Wrigley."
The car stopped in front of a villa. Chen Yushu waved to Chu Mengyao and winked at Lin Yi in front of the car before getting out of the car.
Brother Wrigley? Lin Yi smiled bitterly, this name is quite unique, and it can compete with Brother Ritian on the Internet.
Chen Yushu's home was very close to Chu Mengyao's. The two villas were opposite each other. The car turned a corner and arrived at Chu Mengyao's villa.
Under Chen Yushu's instigation, Chu Mengyao reluctantly accepted the migrant worker in front of her.
However, when she saw the migrant workers carrying luggage and walking into the villa with her, she suddenly burst into tears: "You...why are you following me?"
Lin Yi was stunned and turned to look at Uncle Fu inexplicably: "Don't I live here?"
"You are quite a sentimental person. No man has ever entered my little villa!"
Chu Mengyao pinched her waist and yelled at Lin Yi fiercely.
Uncle Fu wiped the cold sweat from his head. Have you ever had sex with a man? Then who am I...
Uncle Fu thought to himself that it didn't matter if he became a eunuch, but what would Mr. Chu think if he heard what the young lady said?
Seeing Fu Bo wiping his sweat,Chu Mengyao immediately understood that there seemed to be some ambiguity in her words, so she quickly changed her words: "I mean, I have never been with a man outside my family!"
"Miss, Mr. Chu said that you can get along well with Mr. Lin as your own brother... So, Mr. Lin will live in the villa from today on."
Fu Bo said carefully. Uncle Fu knew very well the temper of this little aunt.
"What!"
Chu Mengyao's eyes suddenly widened, and she pointed at Lin Yi with a look of disbelief: "He? My brother? What a joke! Uncle Fu, take him away and let him live wherever he wants!"
"I'm afraid I can't make the decision, miss. This is what Mr. Chu has told me. You see..."
Fu Bo said with some embarrassment.
After all, he is a driver. Although he is Chu Pengzhan's most trusted person, it is really difficult to be caught between him and the lady!
"Forget it, I'll tell Daddy personally!"
Chu Mengyao took out the latest iPhone from her pocket and dialed it. It was launched a while ago. She and Chen Yushu bought one each.
Lin Yi looked at the mobile phone in Chu Mengyao's hand with some envy. Should he also buy one?
Otherwise it would be too inconvenient to make a phone call.
"Daddy, I am Yaoyao!"
